sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravindra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Heard counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State-opposite party.

2. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 153 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of I.P.C.,
Police Station- Karari, District- Kaushambi, during the pendency of trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is a lady and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The incident is alleged to have occurred on 23.06.2023.
The first information report was lodged on 10.07.2023.

There is no explanation for inordinate delay in lodging the F.I.R.
No money was paid to the applicant.
The applicant is not a beneficiary of the illicit transaction.
A vague and general role has been assigned to the applicant.

There is no evidence to link the applicant Kessi vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69610973/
1 with the offence.
The applicant is in jail since 11.07.2023, having no criminal history and in case, she is enlarged on bail, she will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
5. Having heard counsel for the parties and having perused the record this Court prima facie finds that a vague and general role has been assigned to the applicant.
The inordinate delay in lodging the F.I.R. is fatal to the prosecution case.

Further, the applicant is a lady and has no criminal antecedent, and has remained confined for more than two months and after submission of the charge-sheet there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Sachin Mishra  Kessi vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69610973/
2
